name: Lost and Found

gist.Darion, the Blood-Crazy Groundskeeper: All equipment on him shares a single support zone, so there is no limit to what he carries. Whenever he defeats something he equips another piece from hand or deck at half price.
gist.Cecilia, the Harrowing Crusader: Once a turn spends all her gold to delete an artifact from the discard pile and fetch a fresh copy from the deck. Only she carries the Crusader's guns: each fires a small shot a turn and swaps itself for a different one at the end of the turn.
gist.Fern, the Ship Slave: Everything equipped to his heroes costs half.
gist.Cool Repair: Re-equips any equipment from the discard pile for a fraction of its price.
gist.Motharch Squire: Tiny creature: on arrival shuffles two artifacts from the discard pile back into the deck; when it dies, it fetches an artifact.
gist.Club of Gobbo: More Attack, and its hero's attack damage cannot be reduced or cancelled.
gist.Breaking Strike: Discards his own equipment for one hit multiplied by the number of pieces thrown.
gist.Wanted Poster: Draws two whenever its hero defeats a target.
gist.The Sun Sword: Whatever its hero hits burns for the rest of the game.
gist.Gravedigger's Shovel: When its hero defeats a target, the top five cards of your deck go to the discard pile.
gist.Warhorse: Bigger hits on a single target.
gist.Treasure Hunter's Backpack: Puts any piece of equipment from his deck straight onto a hero for nothing; that hero skips his Action this turn.
gist.Bluff: Face-down: draws three when its hero is aimed at.

plan: Keoni keeps hanging tools on Darion — clubs, hammers, a horse, catapults, all in one support zone and at half price through Fern — until a single Heavy Hit is a shed falling on you; Club of Gobbo makes those hits impossible to reduce or cancel. Whatever you remove comes back: Cool Repair, the Squire, Cecilia buying a fresh copy. Breaking Strike cashes the whole toolbox in for one enormous blow, and then he rebuilds it. But Darion only gets his free equips by defeating things, and a deck without creatures gives him nothing to defeat; the build is slow, everything costs gold, and there is one real attacker.

looks.early: A Pocket Catapult and a Club on Darion, Fern counting half prices; a Motharch Squire.
looks.mid: Six pieces of equipment in a single zone; Cecilia's gun changing every turn.
looks.late: Breaking Strike: the whole toolbox thrown at one hero, and Cool Repair picking it up again.

opening.tell: He equips one cheap tool a turn and has not attacked.
opening.why: He needs gold and kills to get going, and you offer nothing to kill. Use the quiet turns; there is nothing to sweep but one Squire, and its death fetches him an artifact.

midgame.tell: Darion carries five tools in a single zone and his Attack has doubled.
midgame.why: One hero is the whole deck: freeze him, and every turn he does not swing the Storm ticks. Removing single tools is pointless — they come back.

crisis.tell: Club of Gobbo is on Darion — his hits cannot be reduced or cancelled — and he is holding Breaking Strike.
crisis.why: Cloud in a Bottle and Homerun! do nothing against the Club. What works is a frozen Darion, a Firewall on the target, and healing out of range.

endgame.tell: Darion is down; Cecilia fires one small gun a turn.
endgame.why: Without him the toolbox has nobody to carry it.
